verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Modal serves an llms.txt at modal.com/llms.txt and plain-markdown versions of its doc pages (e.g., /docs/guide/gpu.md). Modal also ships an official SKILL.md so coding agents can use its latest features. missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g., an llms-full.txt or full doc coverage), and independent reports of agents using these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://modal.com/llms.txt # Modal Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://modal.com/docs/guide/gpu.md # GPU acceleration
Modal distributes an [official skill](./py/modal/skills/modal/SKILL.md) to help coding agents use its latest features.
